null program null program tugz: a new deflate library with three applications October 13, 2026 nullprogram.com/blog/2026/10/13/ I spent a week creating a new deflate implementation from scratch in C named tugz to provide an Info-ZIP -compatible zip program for w64devkit 2.10.1 (released today).
